description_en: This operation obtains configuration samples for a specified resource type
description_zh: 本接口用于获取指定资源类型的配置样例
kebab_example: aliyun config get-resource-configuration-sample --resource-type ACS::ECS::Instance --mock-only false --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetResourceConfigurationSample

parameters.help_en:
The resource type.

For more information about how to obtain the resource type, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169620.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。

关于如何获取类型，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169620.html
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to obtain only mock data, which is not real resource data.
Valid values:

- true

- false
parameters.help_zh:
是否仅获取模拟数据，即非真实资源数据。
取值：
 - true
 - false
parameters.name: mock_only
